name: essay-writer-editor
description: Plan, draft, research, edit, review, and analyse essays while preserving evidence, voice, and reader-focused prose patterns.

interface.longDescription: Write an essay from a topic, brief, notes, rubric, or supplied sources; revise an existing draft; audit or repair repetitive prose patterns; research competing evidence; or review probable AI-writing signals with clear uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Draft an essay from my notes without inventing evidence.
Revise my essay while preserving my argument and voice.
Assess this text for probable AI-writing signals or repair repetitive patterns without changing its meaning.
